description: We’re second-year CS & IT students tackling the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer for the first time. We’re beginners, but curious, fast learners who enjoy web dev and making science fun for kids. Join a friendly team where every idea counts and we aim for a polished, demo-ready game. Looking for: UI/UX or illustration, game dev/3D (Unity, Three.js), frontend (JS/React), educational content writing, and video/pitch editing. Space fans and beginners welcome!
